No other source-run folder or network accessed in batch32 authoring.
provenance.independentCheckDisposition: Historical check: arithmetic passes, remaining issues. New guide incorporates the retained-text Passau 10 ECTS project/abstract condition, Pakistan scholarship restriction, Passau certificate age, Bonn extra-module points and thesis-prose clarification, Saarland referee forms and local-administration timing qualification. Hildesheim binding rules, future dates/fees and evidence-method limits remain open. No new primary research or unconditional eligibility certification.
provenance.originalResearchAccessLimitations: Earlier automatic managed-browser/search fallbacks had unaudited prior storage. Fresh empty-context rereads corroborated selected claims but do not retroactively prove strict clean-session compliance; this is not evidence of credential leakage. Indexed-only fee/jurisdiction/work evidence and timed-out Hildesheim binding PDF remain limited. No clean-session-all-calls claim.
provenance.layoutEvidenceLimit: Source check contains historical desktop/mobile layout evidence. No build, HTML render, new browser check or publication in this authoring pass.

datePolicy: All cited access dates are retained as 2026-11-07, not refreshed by copy editing. Programme contributions are WS2026/27, recurring windows do not confirm WS2027/28, and summer 2027 dates remain labelled. TUM tuition alone explicitly labels winter 2027/28. Provider/insurance fees are dated, not guaranteed 2027 prices.

planningAssumptions.profile: Pakistan-earned four-year BS CS (2026), CGPA 3.2/4.0, age 23, Lahore, junior developer; winter 2027/28 CS/Data Science target. Parental status and official degree-award minimum unknown.
planningAssumptions.salaryMonths: December 2026–September 2027 inclusive; not guaranteed or necessarily available before visa funding deadline
planningAssumptions.exclusions: Tuition; GRE for Saarland; test retakes; new laptop; exceptional verification. Second year needs separate funding. No future German job, unawarded scholarship or unapproved sponsor treated as available funds.
planningAssumptions.status: Rent, food, insurance reserve, miscellaneous living, contributions reserve, permit/test/document/flight/entry-cover/deposit/buffer and FX are assumptions, not supplier quotations. Blocked principal is inside living funding, not another expense.

uncertainties: Official degree-award minimum, module equivalence, independent-project credit assessment, H+ recognition, scientific thesis suitability and top-10% rank remain applicant-specific; no admission probability.

Passau 10 ECTS project/abstract/full-paper gate and two-year certificate age were omitted in the source guide but corroborated by retained primary text; Bonn points concern qualifying extra module grades, not overall GPA. Koblenz motivation letter and Saarland referee forms need complete programme instructions.

All winter 2027/28 application windows and semester contributions unverified; Bonn/Trier winter windows absent; other windows recurring only. Early Saarland November round is for following winter, not a reason to wait until January.
Hildesheim exact grade floor, operative ranking weights and TOEFL test type unresolved; binding PDF timed out. Koblenz/Hildesheim new-enrolment contribution differences unknown.

2027 visa blocked amount, personalised document/attestation list, entry-cover duration, insurer tariff and actual enrolment-compatible coverage unknown. Pakistan scholarship recognition must be checked; Pakistani-university award insufficient, HEC award accepted in the mission context.

No routine APS for Pakistan-earned degree found; qualification-country exceptions and future extra verification remain possible. HEC admission stamps do not equal consular certified-copy requirements; no blanket HEC/IBCC/MOFA visa chain established.
No numerical current appointment/precheck wait or promised decision/arrival established. Generic arrival administration is a planning checklist; exact local statutory timing source not established.

Housing, flights, test tariffs, bank selling/transfer rate and fees unquoted. Twelve Expatrio charged months can understate earlier-opening costs. Deposit ties up funds; blocked balance not freely available on arrival. Ten salary months may not precede funding deadline.
Budget no at assumed FX; all-salary and 60% savings scenarios remain short. Tuition exceptions, GRE/retakes/equipment, exceptional verification and year two need additional funds.
Historic clean-session method exception remains unresolved; indexed-only and inaccessible-rule evidence limits retained; no new external verification or render certification.
